body.rule: a family is the counted unit and a package alias is never one: identities are collapsed by canonical project name, so `curl`, `curl-dev`, `curl-doc`, Debian `libcurl4` and Fedora/Alpine `libcurl` are one family, and the OpenSSL providers (`openssl`, `libssl3`, `libcrypto3`, `openssl@3`) are one non-consumer group that is excluded rather than counted. A fork is not independent without explicit evidence of materially different OpenSSL integration.
